entry.title: Cadenza 0.25.0
entry.summary: Cadenza 0.25.0 for the Akai Force (MPC OS 3.x). Chord-driven generative MIDI sequencer: pick a key and scale, shape chords, bass and melody with a few knobs per page. Install: unzip and run `install.sh` on the device as root (see INSTALL.md inside the zip), or install it through the mpc-vst-plugins catalog once listed there. Bench (Gen1 device, Cortex-A17): p99 39.9%, worst block 55.5%.
